sentences.text: Its keyboard is the most comfortable of the three, which matters most for long coding.
Battery life is strong, so you can work a full day away from a plug.

trade_off: The Orion Play 15 compiles faster, but it is much heavier.

sentences.text: It is the lightest of the three and slightly faster than the Nova Book 14.

trade_off: Its battery life is disputed: the maker says 10 hours, an owner reports about 6.
